en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large half-timbered house with a tiled roof and dormer windows, labeled as an electricity works and post office. In front of the building stand several people, including a man on horseback, a man in uniform, and others near the entrance. The setting appears rural, with trees, a stone wall, wooden fence, and work materials stacked beside the house. The text is printed in German at the top and in red at the bottom, with a handwritten number in red ink in the upper right corner.
